'''Dennik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Republic Army]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denova]], he assisted the Republic forces in the [[Battle of Denova|fighting]] against [[Kephess]]'s renegade forces.
